_comment: Publish policy for the FreeUnit knowledge base site.
One file, so the decision is reviewable and diffable rather than hidden
in the renderer.
areas       which top-level directories are read at all. An area that is
not named here is never opened by the build, so strategy/
and team.md cannot reach the site even by accident. This is
the control that guards the private boundary.
root_files  loose documents at the knowledge base root that are published.
exclude     slugs dropped after the area check. Slugs only.
report_only when true, list what would be published and write nothing.
The tree that this policy reads already contains nothing private and
nothing off-topic: that is enforced where the files are chosen, not here.
This file keeps the second line of defence, so that a document reaching
the tree by mistake still cannot reach the site.
There was once a `subject` rule here that dropped documents mentioning a
sibling project by counting mentions in the text. It was removed after
the documents themselves were removed from the tree, which is the
stronger control: a rule that filters at render time leaves the document
sitting in a public repository for anyone who reads the source. The
`subject` mechanism is still implemented in report/render.py and can be
reinstated in this file if a future case needs it.
